summary: Frontend regression testing covered first-visit entry, day/night switching, night scenery, reload persistence, Settings theme controls, and Local Multiplayer memorization-to-play transition. Core requested flows passed; Single Player post-game navigation was not conclusively verified because the final selector assertion did not resolve.
action_items: Re-verify Single Player remains visible after exiting Local Multiplayer from the menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings accessibility Toggle buttons do not expose data-testid attributes, reducing robust automated coverage even though theme controls do.

context_for_next_testing_agent: First visit, returning-user Continue flow, theme toggle, stars/night scenery, theme persistence, Settings Day/Night controls, multiplayer names, 5-second face-up memorization, disabled cards, transition to Player 1, and post-transition card selection were exercised. Backend supervisor was FATAL/unavailable, but these flows did not call backend APIs.
rca of the issue: The final Single Player assertion produced an empty assertion failure after exiting multiplayer; likely menu state/accessible-name mismatch or navigation timing, but it was not reproduced enough to identify a business-logic root cause. No source changes were made.
